description: Ordered CUDA-to-SYCL migration task plan for llama.cpp ggml backend. Tasks are ordered by priority: infrastructure (1-2) -> simple kernels (3) -> medium kernels (4) -> complex kernels (5) -> integration test (6).

tasks.name: Verify SYCL build and existing backend
tasks.description: Build llama.cpp with GGML_SYCL=ON on b60, verify existing MUL_MAT/MUL_MAT_ID/OUT_PROD ops pass unit tests, establish baseline.
tasks.notes: Build succeeds with SYCL ON (icx/icpx, GGML_SYCL_F16=ON). 122 ops listed. MUL_MAT: 729/729 pass. MUL_MAT_ID: 576/576 pass. OUT_PROD: 4/4 pass. bf16 and some iq2_xxs not supported. Intel BMG GPU (0xe211), 160 CUs, 24GB VRAM, driver 1.13.35563+7.
steps: Remote build:
Run: bash syclgen/remote_run.sh -s b60 -t build --list-ops -e ZES_ENABLE_SYSMAN=1
Run existing MUL_MAT test: bash syclgen/remote_run.sh -s b60 -t unit -k MUL_MAT -e ZES_ENABLE_SYSMAN=1
Run existing OUT_PROD test: bash syclgen/remote_run.sh -s b60 -t unit -k OUT_PROD -e ZES_ENABLE_SYSMAN=1
Document baseline results in syclgen/progress.txt

tasks.name: Create SYCL helper utilities and common patterns
tasks.description: Establish common SYCL warp-reduction helpers, sub-group shuffle wrappers, and element-wise kernel dispatch templates in common.hpp/common.cpp that will be reused across all migrated kernels. Warp size = 16 for Intel.
tasks.notes: Added block_reduce framework (SUM/MAX) to common.hpp (lines 505-624). Added unary kernel dispatch templates (unary_op_kernel, unary_sycl, ggml_sycl_op_unary) and gated variants to element_wise.cpp. Implemented 24 activation functions and 30 concrete wrapper functions. Build succeeds on b60 with icpx. MUL_MAT 729/729 regression test passes.
steps: Audit ggml/src/ggml-sycl/common.hpp for existing sub_group reduction helpers
Add warp_reduce_sum, warp_reduce_max sub-group helpers if not present
Add element_wise_kernel_1src and element_wise_kernel_2src SYCL templates
Build and verify no compilation errors
Document new utilities in syclgen/progress.txt

tasks.name: Migrate SCALE op
tasks.description: Implement ggml_sycl_op_scale. Simple element-wise: dst = x * scale + bias. No existing SYCL stub file.
tasks.notes: Implemented ggml_sycl_op_scale in ggml-sycl.cpp (lines 3121-3151). Uses parallel_for with nd_range, block_size=256, grid-stride loop. Wired into compute_forward and supports_op returns true. SCALE: 4/4 tests passed. MUL_MAT regression: 729/729 passed.
steps: Read CUDA scale.cu (19 lines of host wrapper + 14 line kernel) to understand logic
Implement ggml_sycl_op_scale using sycl::parallel_for in ggml-sycl.cpp or a new scale.cpp
Wire into compute_forward switch: case GGML_OP_SCALE -> call ggml_sycl_op_scale
Add GGML_OP_SCALE to supports_op returning true
Build with GGML_SYCL=ON
Check op name with --list-ops
Run unit test: bash syclgen/remote_run.sh -s b60 -t unit -k SCALE -e ZES_ENABLE_SYSMAN=1
Update syclgen/progress.txt

tasks.name: Migrate DIAG_MASK_INF op
tasks.description: Implement ggml_sycl_op_diag_mask_inf. Simple element-wise conditional: set to -inf above diagonal. No existing SYCL stub.
tasks.notes: Implemented ggml_sycl_op_diag_mask_inf in ggml-sycl.cpp (lines 3153-3189). Uses 2D nd_range with local(1,32), global(nrows, ceil(ncols/32)*32). Kernel: dst[i] = src0[i] - (col > n_past + row % rows_per_channel) * FLT_MAX. Wired into compute_forward and supports_op. DIAG_MASK_INF: 3/3 tests passed. SCALE regression: 4/4 passed.

tasks.name: Migrate unary ops (element-wise activations)
tasks.description: Implement the generic unary_op_kernel in SYCL. Single kernel handles all simple activations: SILU, GELU, RELU, TANH, SIGMOID, EXP, ABS, NEG, STEP, etc. Existing empty stub: element_wise.cpp.
tasks.notes: Wired 22 unary ops from element_wise.cpp into compute_forward and supports_op. Added 4 new implementations: expm1, leaky_relu (with negative_slope param), silu_back (two-input), xielu (4 params). Fixed bug: added ggml_is_contiguous check to supports_op for GGML_OP_UNARY to match CUDA backend. Also wired standalone ops: SQR, SQRT, SIN, COS, LOG, LEAKY_RELU, SILU_BACK. Tests: SILU 4/4, GELU 4/4, RELU 4/4, TANH 4/4, SIGMOID 4/4, SQR 6/6, SQRT 6/6, SIN 6/6, COS 6/6, LOG 6/6, LEAKY_RELU 7/7, SILU_BACK 1/1. Regression: SCALE 4/4, MUL_MAT 729/729.

Implement all 22+ unary sub-ops: ABS, SGN, NEG, STEP, GELU, SILU, GELU_ERF, GELU_QUICK, TANH, RELU, SIGMOID, HARDSIGMOID, HARDSWISH, EXP, ELU, XIELU, FLOOR, CEIL, ROUND, TRUNC, EXPM1, SOFTPLUS

tasks.name: Migrate RMS_NORM op
tasks.description: Implement rms_norm_f32 kernel. Requires warp-level reduction (sub_group). Existing empty stub: norm.cpp.
tasks.notes: Implemented ggml_sycl_op_rms_norm in norm.cpp (96 lines). Uses 1D nd_range with block_size=256, block_reduce<SUM> for cross-warp reduction + shared memory broadcast. Fixed two issues: (1) block_reduce only returns correct value to sub-group 0 — added broadcast via shared memory, (2) block_size=1024 exceeded the 2-level reduction capacity with WARP_SIZE=16 (64 warps > 16 lanes) — fixed by always using block_size=256 (16 warps = 1 warp of reduction). Supports non-contiguous source via element strides, contiguous destination. Wired into compute_forward and supports_op (F32 only). RMS_NORM: 17/17 tests passed. SCALE regression: 4/4 passed.
